problem.statement: جمهور AI automation for small businesses يواجه مشاكل متكررة مدعومة بأدلة
pain_points: I run a tiny online store and I waste 3 hours every day answering the same customer questions. I can't afford a support team.
Every tutorial assumes I already know how to code. Nobody explains AI automation for non-technical shop owners in plain language.

recommended_product.reason: حقوق غير مؤكدة أو استعداد دفع أقل → أفيليت أأمن (عمولة بدون إنتاج)

clusters.sample_excerpt: I run a tiny online store and I waste 3 hours every day answering the same customer questions. I can't afford a support team.
Is there a simple guide to automate my customer replies with AI without hiring a developer? Willing to pay for something that just works.
I'd happily pay $30-50 for a step-by-step ebook that shows exactly how to set up AI automation for a one-person business.
Most existing courses on AI automation are $500+ and aimed at agencies, not solo owners. Gap for affordable beginner material.
Every tutorial assumes I already know how to code. Nobody explains AI automation for non-technical shop owners in plain language.
Search interest for 'AI for small business' has grown steadily over the last 90 days across multiple regions.
